narration.vuequests.linear_list_usage: Use Up and Down to select a quest. Scroll to browse available and completed quests. Press Tab for quest details.
narration.vuequests.linear_details_usage: Scroll or use Up, Down, Page Up and Page Down to read. Use Left and Right to select an objective or reward, then Enter or Space to interact or claim.
screen.vuequests.reward.command_invalid: The quest reward command is invalid or unavailable.
narration.vuequests.panel_usage: Use Tab or the arrow keys to move between entries. Press Enter or Space to select.
narration.vuequests.canvas_usage: Use Tab or the arrow keys to browse quests. Press Enter or Space to open quest details. Use the mouse wheel to zoom. By default, hold Shift and press the arrow keys to pan, use plus and minus to zoom, and press Home to recenter. Canvas shortcuts can be changed in Controls.
narration.vuequests.details_usage: Use the up and down arrows or Page Up and Page Down to scroll. Press Escape to close.
